drhp.business: The company operates across four interlinked segments: cargo handling and freight forwarding, transportation (including project logistics, 3PL and freight forwarding), warehousing and distribution, and other services including coastal movement. It serves customers such as automobile, west paper, textile and steel industries across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, and recently launched a domestic logistics vertical spanning surface, rail, coastal and multimodal transport.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India's transport and logistics industry is in a structural upcycle, supported by policy tailwinds, heavy infrastructure spend, and sustained demand from manufacturing, e-commerce, and consumption.
- Government logistics-cost reduction (PM Gati Shakti, National Logistics Policy) and Dedicated Freight Corridor completion are improving transit reliability and reducing turnaround times, which management frames as a sector tailwind.
- Grade-A warehousing demand is being driven by 3PL demand, e-commerce fulfilment, and high-spec automation adoption, with institutional stock continuing a …

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Pursuing a focused strategy in the transportation segment as part of an expansion roadmap, including fleet augmentation.
- Planning further vehicle acquisitions to build on FY26 fleet expansion momentum and reinforce competitive positioning.
- Positioning the company on multimodal capability, network density, technology (tracking, WMS/TMS), and sustainability (EVs/alt-fuels, green warehousing) to capture market share as policy-led costs fall.
